name: Chaos Baby Yoshimi #2 Tomimochi Natsuki Hen
original_name: カオスBaby義美＃2 富持奈津姫編
source:
Main character Shinichi saves a girl from a molester and now wants to keep platonic relations with her. However, girl herself wants to devote both her mind and body as a gratitude. Yoshimi can not miss this "funny situation" and meddles their relations as the head of "psychotherapy club" she hosts.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角新一从猥亵者手中救了一名女孩，现在想与她保持柏拉图式的关系。然而，女孩自己却想奉献自己的身心来报恩。吉美不能错过这个“有趣的情况”，并作为她主持的“心理治疗俱乐部”的负责人插手他们的关系。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
